【原视频简介】
Making the classic lemon battery using nothing more than lemons, copper wire, and galvanized nails.

Along the way, we discuss how a lemon battery works, what oxidation and reduction are, why zinc and copper create electricity, and how this simple experiment is directly related to modern batteries. 

From Alessandro Volta's original voltaic pile to today's alkaline and lithium-ion batteries, they all rely on the same fundamental electrochemical principles.

Whether you're interested in physics, chemistry, electronics, STEM projects, or hands-on science experiments, this video explains the concepts in a clear, visual way that's perfect for students, teachers, hobbyists, and anyone curious about electricity.
Topics covered:• Lemon battery experiment• Galvanic (voltaic) cells• Oxidation and reduction• Anodes and cathodes• Electrolytes and electron flow• Batteries connected in series• How modern batteries work
